title: bug: request_replan frees the caller's seat but answers nextAction moe.wait_for_task "pick up a different task", the in-session claim hint report_blocked's seat-freeing arm dropped in 43f6dd55, so a worker that follows it claims a second task in a session whose pinned attempt identity makes every start_step there fail ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED
description:
Found by defect hunt #10 (task-49a2c07f, architect-1dd28c7c) on 2026-11-03. The holder re-ran the repro and re-derived the lines below at HEAD 677d051a.

PROBLEM
- request_replan (requestReplan.ts:108-111) answers `nextAction: { tool: 'moe.wait_for_task', args: { workerId, statuses: ['WORKING'] }, reason: 'Replan requested; wait for an architect to re-plan or pick up a different task.' }`.
- By the time it answers, its PLANNING write has already cleared the assignee and closed the attempt (MCP_SERVER.md "Close on hand-back").
- Its seat-freeing sibling refuses that hint on purpose. report_blocked (reportBlocked.ts:485-500, :528):
  - its comment reads "A claim hint here contradicts the one-task-per-wrapper contract … Return terminal handoff guidance, never an executable next-task hint";
  - it returns nextAction undefined when it frees the seat;
  - it returns sessionHandoff { action: 'END_SESSION', taskId, workerId, reason } for the seat, never for a governor, and not when the seat's record already names another currentTaskId.
- That fix is 43f6dd55 (2026-09-10). It never reached request_replan.
- No role doc or skill mentions request_replan, so this hint is the only next step a worker gets.
- A wrapper-launched worker that follows it waits, wakes and claims another WORKING task inside the same session. moe-proxy stamps the session's MOE_ATTEMPT_ID/MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION onto start_step, and those still name the replanned task's closed attempt, so every start_step there is refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED.
- Otherwise the seat parks in wait_for_task, which delays the wrapper's exit checkpoint of the replanned task's bytes.

EVIDENCE: repro at HEAD 677d051a, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the checkout
- Files: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-49a2c07f/B/zzHuntB_replanHandoff.test.ts, output in R_replanHandoff.out.txt.
- Command: `cd packages/moe-daemon && NO_COLOR=1 npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntB_replanHandoff.test.ts`
- Control (passes): report_blocked by the assignee frees the seat, returns no nextAction and returns sessionHandoff END_SESSION.
- Fails: request_replan by the assignee gives `- "nextActionTool": undefined, + "nextActionTool": "moe.wait_for_task"` and `- "sessionHandoff": "END_SESSION", + "sessionHandoff": undefined`.
- Evidence case (passes at HEAD), following the hint:
  1. wait_for_task returns a claim hint.
  2. claim_next_task assigns task-b to worker-1.
  3. start_step on task-b, carrying the pinned task-a identity, is refused with codeName ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED. The repro runs the default profile, not verified-local.
- Result: Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3).

FIX DIRECTION
- In requestReplan.ts, mirror report_blocked's seat-freeing arm:
  - return no executable nextAction (no `tool`);
  - return sessionHandoff { action: 'END_SESSION', taskId, workerId, reason } for the prior assignee, or for the caller when the task had no assignee and the caller is not a governor (resolveWorkerRole);
  - skip the handoff when that seat's worker record already names another currentTaskId;
  - reuse report_blocked's reason wording: "End this session so the wrapper can checkpoint the task it launched. Do not call moe.claim_next_task or moe.wait_for_task inside this session."
- The moe-account-switch mod already honours a top-level END_SESSION for the seat (scripts/CLAUDE.md, Claude account rotation), so no wrapper or mod change is needed.
- Everything else stays as today: the PLANNING status, the null assignee, priorAttempt, the closed attempt and the #architects line.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md: the request_replan Returns block (:2880-2892) documents `nextAction: { tool: "moe.wait_for_task", args, reason }` and goes stale. 0adea941 holds that file at filing time, so it is not in this row's files. Add the sync only if lanes.js shows the file free when you plan; otherwise the governor files it.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/requestReplan.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/requestReplan.test.ts (new; the tool has no test file of its own)
- Neither file is held at filing time.

VERIFICATION
Run vitest in a snapshot or the task worktree, never in the shared checkout: `npx vitest run src/tools/requestReplan.test.ts src/tools/reportBlocked.test.ts`.
definitionOfDone: In the new requestReplan.test.ts, an assignee's request_replan returns no nextAction whose tool is moe.wait_for_task or moe.claim_next_task, and returns sessionHandoff.action 'END_SESSION' carrying that taskId and workerId.
In the same file, a governor's request_replan on an unassigned WORKING task returns no END_SESSION handoff, and neither does a call whose seat's worker record already names another currentTaskId.

In the same file, the task still ends PLANNING with assignedWorkerId null, priorAttempt set and its attempt closed. `npx vitest run src/tools/requestReplan.test.ts src/tools/reportBlocked.test.ts` passes.
